name: Zaman (Ankoku no Hotel Oujou o Tsubuse!)
original_name: ザーマン(暗黒のホテル王嬢を潰せ!)
source:
Just as there is always shadow where there is light, evil never ceases in any era. Even in modern society, there is evil that goes unpunished.
There was a man who single-handedly confronted such evil and made it his mission to deliver judgment himself. Using his ability to manipulate women at will, he brought down the hammer of justice on rampant evil. His name was "Zarman".

The man giving the opening speech at the grand opening party of a new hotel, a hotel built with the utmost luxury, was Tsuzuki, the president of the Sekimoto Group, a man known for his exceptional business acumen. It would not be an exaggeration to say that the prosperity of the group that controls the Japanese business world is built upon the countless corpses that Tsuzuki has created.
The dark hotel king, Tsuzuki had come to be known by that nickname. This time, Zarman's target was Tsuzuki, and his only daughter, Reika. And so, Zarman infiltrated the party venue.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/198201/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
正如有光明的地方就有阴影一样，任何时代邪恶都不会停止。即使在现代社会，也有逍遥法外的恶行。
有一个人，他单枪匹马地对抗这样的邪恶，并以亲自审判为己任。他利用自己随意操纵女性的能力，向猖獗的邪恶敲响了正义之锤。他的名字叫“扎曼”。

在一家极其奢华的新酒店的开业典礼上发表开幕致辞的人，是关本集团的社长都筑，他以非凡的商业头脑而闻名。毫不夸张地说，掌控日本商界的集团的繁荣是建立在都筑所制造的无数尸体之上的。
黑暗旅馆之王都筑就是以这个绰号而闻名的。这次，扎曼的目标是都筑和他唯一的女儿丽香。于是，扎曼潜入了聚会场地。
